recovered_entries.endogenous_note: The active constituents are withanolides, steroidal lactones such as withaferin A and withanolide A, built in the plant from mevalonate-derived sterols. Humans make sterols but not withanolides, and there is no human enzyme that produces the withanolide lactone ring. Nothing about ashwagandha can be framed as replacing something the body has run short of.
recovered_entries.endogenous_note_zh: 活性成分是 withanolides, 即 withaferin A 和 withanolide A 这类甾体内酯, 在植物体内由甲羟戊酸途径来源的甾醇构建。人能合成甾醇, 不能合成 withanolides, 也没有任何人类酶能生成 withanolide 的内酯环。因此不能把服用南非醉茄说成补充身体短缺的东西。
recovered_entries.pathway: NOT APPLICABLE. Withanolide biosynthesis proceeds in Withania somnifera from 24-methylenecholesterol through plant cytochrome P450 oxidations; absent from human tissue.
recovered_entries.pathway_zh: NOT APPLICABLE。Withanolide 的生物合成在 Withania somnifera 中由 24-methylenecholesterol 经植物 cytochrome P450 氧化完成; 人体组织中不存在该途径。
recovered_entries.daily_amount_zh: 0 (人体没有相应的生物合成途径)
recovered_entries.still_matters_when: Nothing on this axis. Screen on trial quality for the claimed indication (stress, sleep, testosterone), extract standardisation to withanolide content, and reported hepatotoxicity and thyroid effects.
recovered_entries.still_matters_when_zh: 这条轴上没有理由。改用所声称适应症 (压力, 睡眠, 睾酮) 的试验质量, 提取物按 withanolide 含量的标准化, 以及已报告的肝毒性和甲状腺影响来筛查。
recovered_entries.source: PMID 37063285 (Bashir A, Front Pharmacol 2023, An updated review on phytochemistry and molecular targets of Withania somnifera)

recovered_entries.endogenous_note: The marker compounds are salidroside, a tyrosol glucoside, plus the cinnamyl glycosides rosavin, rosin and rosarin, all made in the rhizome. Tyrosol itself occurs endogenously in humans as a metabolite of tyramine (tyramine to 4-hydroxyphenylacetaldehyde to tyrosol), and hydroxytyrosol arises the same way from dopamine, so the aglycone is present in humans. The missing capability is the specific UDP-glucosyltransferase that forms the salidroside O-glucoside, since human phase II conjugation of phenols runs to glucuronides and sulfates, and there is no route to the cinnamyl glycosides. recovered_entries.endogenous_note_zh: 标志物是 salidroside (酪醇葡糖苷) 以及 cinnamyl 糖苷 rosavin, rosin 和 rosarin, 都在根茎中合成。酪醇本身在人体内源存在, 由 tyramine 代谢而来 (tyramine 经 4-hydroxyphenylacetaldehyde 生成酪醇), 羟基酪醇同样由多巴胺经这条路生成, 所以苷元在人体中是有的。缺的是形成 salidroside O-葡糖苷的那个特定 UDP-glucosyltransferase, 因为人对酚类的二相结合走葡糖醛酸化和硫酸化, 而且也没有生成 cinnamyl 糖苷的途径。对 salidroside 和 rosavins 而言 NONE 成立, 所以这条轴既不给出服用的理由, 也不给出否定的理由, 判断完全落到临床证据上。
recovered_entries.pathway: NOT APPLICABLE for salidroside and the rosavins. Plant phenylpropanoid and shikimate routes in Rhodiola rosea rhizome produce tyrosol, salidroside and the rosavins. Tyrosol is endogenous in humans via tyramine, but no human glucosyltransferase forms the salidroside O-glucoside and no human enzyme assembles the cinnamyl glycosides.
recovered_entries.pathway_zh: 对 salidroside 和 rosavins 为 NOT APPLICABLE。Rhodiola rosea 根茎中的植物苯丙烷类和莽草酸途径生成酪醇, salidroside 和 rosavins。酪醇在人体经 tyramine 内源生成, 但没有人类 glucosyltransferase 形成 salidroside 的 O-葡糖苷, 也没有人类酶组装 cinnamyl 糖苷。
recovered_entries.daily_amount: 0 (no human biosynthetic pathway for salidroside or the rosavins)

recovered_entries.still_matters_when_zh: 这条轴上没有理由。改用标准化 (通常 3% rosavins 和 1% salidroside), 商业上常见的物种冒充, 以及在疲劳和运动表现方面有限且不一致的试验证据来筛查。

recovered_entries.endogenous_note: Valerian's activity is attributed to valerenic acid and the valepotriates, sesquiterpenes whose carbon skeleton is built by a plant terpene synthase (valerenadiene synthase) found in Valeriana officinalis roots. Humans use farnesyl diphosphate for sterols, dolichol, the polyprenyl side chain of ubiquinone (CoQ10), the farnesyl group of heme A and protein farnesylation and geranylgeranylation, and have no sesquiterpene cyclase to close a valerenane ring. So nothing in a valerian capsule is endogenous, a deficiency framing is unavailable, and the modest and inconsistent insomnia evidence has to stand on its own.
recovered_entries.endogenous_note_zh: 缬草的作用被归于 valerenic acid 和 valepotriates, 这些倍半萜的碳骨架由 Valeriana officinalis 根中的植物萜类合成酶 (valerenadiene synthase) 构建。人把 farnesyl diphosphate 用于甾醇, dolichol, 泛醌 (CoQ10) 的多聚异戊烯侧链, heme A 的法尼基基团以及蛋白的法尼基化和香叶基香叶基化, 但没有能闭合 valerenane 环的倍半萜环化酶。所以缬草胶囊里没有任何内源成分, 缺乏这套说法用不上, 有限且不一致的失眠证据只能自己站住。
recovered_entries.pathway: NOT APPLICABLE. Farnesyl diphosphate is cyclised by the plant sesquiterpene synthase valerenadiene synthase in Valeriana officinalis, then oxidised to valerenic acid. Human farnesyl diphosphate goes to sterols, dolichol, ubiquinone, heme A and prenylated proteins; there is no human sesquiterpene cyclase.
recovered_entries.pathway_zh: NOT APPLICABLE。在 Valeriana officinalis 中, farnesyl diphosphate 由植物倍半萜合成酶 valerenadiene synthase 环化, 再氧化为 valerenic acid。人的 farnesyl diphosphate 去向是甾醇, dolichol, 泛醌, heme A 和异戊烯化蛋白; 人体没有倍半萜环化酶。
recovered_entries.daily_amount_zh: 0 (人体没有相应的生物合成途径)
recovered_entries.still_matters_when: Nothing on this axis. Screen on the weak and heterogeneous insomnia trial data, wide variation in valerenic acid content between products, and additive sedation with alcohol and benzodiazepines.
recovered_entries.still_matters_when_zh: 这条轴上没有理由。改用薄弱且异质的失眠试验数据, 不同产品间 valerenic acid 含量的巨大差异, 以及与酒精和苯二氮类的镇静叠加来筛查。
recovered_entries.source: PMID 34898176 (Zinck GE, Biochemistry 2021, Structurally Guided Reprogramming of Valerenadiene Synthase)

recovered_entries.endogenous_note: Standardised extracts contain flavonol glycosides of quercetin and kaempferol plus the terpene trilactones ginkgolide A, B, C, J and bilobalide, a group of molecules found only in Ginkgo biloba. No human tissue produces flavonoids or ginkgolides, so intake is entirely exogenous. That removes any deficiency-correction claim and leaves the outcome trials, which have been largely negative for preventing cognitive decline.
recovered_entries.endogenous_note_zh: 标准化提取物含槲皮素和山奈酚的黄酮醇糖苷, 以及萜类三内酯 ginkgolide A, B, C, J 和 bilobalide, 这组分子只见于 Ginkgo biloba。人体任何组织都不产生类黄酮或银杏内酯, 所以摄入完全是外源的。这样一来纠正缺乏的说法就不成立, 只剩结局试验, 而这些试验在预防认知衰退上大体为阴性。
recovered_entries.pathway: NOT APPLICABLE. Flavonoids arise from the plant phenylpropanoid pathway and the terpene trilactones from plant terpenoid biosynthesis unique to Ginkgo biloba; neither pathway exists in humans.
recovered_entries.pathway_zh: NOT APPLICABLE。类黄酮来自植物苯丙烷类途径, 萜类三内酯来自 Ginkgo biloba 特有的植物萜类生物合成; 这两条途径人体都没有。
recovered_entries.daily_amount_zh: 0 (人体没有相应的生物合成途径)
recovered_entries.still_matters_when: Nothing on this axis. Screen on the negative large prevention trials, extract standardisation (EGb 761 type: 24 percent flavone glycosides, 6 percent terpene lactones), and bleeding risk with antiplatelet and anticoagulant drugs.
recovered_entries.still_matters_when_zh: 这条轴上没有理由。改用大型预防试验的阴性结果, 提取物标准化 (EGb 761 型: 24% 黄酮糖苷, 6% 萜内酯), 以及与抗血小板和抗凝药合用的出血风险来筛查。
recovered_entries.source: PMID 26604665 (Nash KM, Integr Med Insights 2015, Current Perspectives on the Beneficial Role of Ginkgo biloba in Neurological and Cerebrovascular Disorders)

recovered_entries.endogenous_note: The active fraction is the bacosides, dammarane-type triterpenoid saponins from the plant. Humans cyclise 2,3-oxidosqualene through the protosteryl cation to lanosterol and then to cholesterol and have no dammarenediol synthase, so the dammarane skeleton is never formed at all, and no human glycosyltransferase attaches the bacoside sugar chains. There is no endogenous pool to top up, so the case rests on the cognition trials, which show a small effect on memory acquisition after weeks of dosing.
recovered_entries.endogenous_note_zh: 活性组分是 bacosides, 属植物来源的达玛烷型三萜皂苷。人把 2,3-oxidosqualene 经原甾醇正离子环化为 lanosterol 再到胆固醇, 没有 dammarenediol synthase, 所以达玛烷骨架在人体中根本不会形成, 也没有人类 glycosyltransferase 接上 bacoside 的糖链。没有内源池可补, 所以判断靠认知试验, 而这些试验显示连续给药数周后对记忆获得有小幅作用。
recovered_entries.pathway: NOT APPLICABLE. Plant triterpenoid saponin biosynthesis in Bacopa monnieri routes 2,3-oxidosqualene through the dammarenyl cation via dammarenediol synthase, then glycosyltransferases. Human oxidosqualene cyclase routes the same substrate through the protosteryl cation to lanosterol, so no dammarane intermediate exists in humans.
recovered_entries.pathway_zh: NOT APPLICABLE。Bacopa monnieri 的植物三萜皂苷合成把 2,3-oxidosqualene 经达玛烯基正离子由 dammarenediol synthase 处理, 再经 glycosyltransferases 糖基化。人的 oxidosqualene cyclase 把同一底物经原甾醇正离子导向 lanosterol, 所以人体中不存在达玛烷中间体。
recovered_entries.daily_amount_zh: 0 (人体没有相应的生物合成途径)
recovered_entries.still_matters_when: Nothing on this axis. Screen on the small measured effect (chiefly delayed word recall), the 12 week timescale before any effect appears, bacoside standardisation, and gastrointestinal side effects.
recovered_entries.still_matters_when_zh: 这条轴上没有理由。改用实测效应之小 (主要是延迟词语回忆), 起效需要 12 周的时间尺度, bacoside 标准化, 以及胃肠道不良反应来筛查。
recovered_entries.source: PMID 24252493 (Kongkeaw C, J Ethnopharmacol 2014, Meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials on cognitive effects of Bacopa monnieri extract)

recovered_entries.endogenous_note: The compounds of interest are hericenones from the fruiting body, polyketide-terpenoid hybrids (meroterpenoids) built on a polyketide-derived resorcinol or benzaldehyde core carrying an added prenyl or geranyl chain and a fatty acyl group, and erinacines, cyathane diterpenoids, from the mycelium. These are fungal metabolites; human cells produce neither, and human cells also do not need them for anything. Any benefit has to come from the pharmacology of an ingested fungal compound, and the human evidence is one small trial in mild cognitive impairment (30 subjects, 16 weeks of dosing) with scores falling back 4 w ...
recovered_entries.endogenous_note_zh: 受关注的成分是子实体中的 hericenones, 属聚酮与萜类的杂合分子 (meroterpenoids), 核心是聚酮来源的间苯二酚或苯甲醛结构, 上面带异戊烯或香叶基链和脂肪酰基; 以及菌丝体中的 erinacines, 属 cyathane 二萜。这些都是真菌代谢物; 人细胞既不产生它们, 也不需要它们做任何事。任何益处只能来自摄入真菌化合物的药理作用, 而人体证据是一项轻度认知障碍的小型试验 (30 名受试者, 给药 16 周), 停药 4 周后评分回落。
recovered_entries.pathway: NOT APPLICABLE. Hericenones are fungal polyketide-terpenoid hybrids (meroterpenoids) and erinacines are cyathane diterpenoids, both made in Hericium erinaceus; no human pathway to either.
recovered_entries.pathway_zh: NOT APPLICABLE。Hericenones 是真菌聚酮萜类杂合物 (meroterpenoids), erinacines 是 cyathane 二萜, 两者都在 Hericium erinaceus 中生成; 人体对两者都没有合成途径。
recovered_entries.daily_amount_zh: 0 (人体没有相应的生物合成途径)
recovered_entries.still_matters_when: Nothing on this axis. Screen on the thin human evidence base (30 subjects, 16 weeks, benefit lost 4 weeks after cessation), whether a product is fruiting body or grain-based mycelium, and the fact that nerve growth factor induction is a cell and rodent finding rather than a human one.
recovered_entries.still_matters_when_zh: 这条轴上没有理由。改用人体证据之薄 (30 名受试者, 16 周, 停药 4 周后获益消失), 产品是子实体还是谷物基菌丝体, 以及神经生长因子诱导只是细胞和啮齿类的发现, 不是人体发现, 来筛查。
recovered_entries.source: PMID 18844328 (Mori K, Phytother Res 2009, Improving effects of the mushroom Yamabushitake (Hericium erinaceus) on mild cognitive impairment)

recovered_entries.endogenous_note: The relevant constituents are hypericin, a naphthodianthrone, and hyperforin, a prenylated phloroglucinol, both made only by Hypericum perforatum. Humans synthesise neither, so nothing here is replacement. On this one the axis being silent matters less than the interaction profile: hyperforin activates PXR and induces CYP3A4, which cuts blood levels of oral contraceptives, ciclosporin, warfarin and HIV protease inhibitors.
recovered_entries.endogenous_note_zh: 相关成分是 hypericin (一种萘骈二蒽酮) 和 hyperforin (一种异戊烯化间苯三酚), 只由 Hypericum perforatum 合成。人两者都不合成, 所以这里谈不上替代。这一条上, 这条轴无话可说的意义远小于相互作用特征: hyperforin 激活 PXR 并诱导 CYP3A4, 会降低口服避孕药, 环孢素, 华法林和 HIV 蛋白酶抑制剂的血药水平。
recovered_entries.pathway: NOT APPLICABLE. Plant polyketide and phloroglucinol pathways in Hypericum perforatum; no human homologue.
recovered_entries.pathway_zh: NOT APPLICABLE。Hypericum perforatum 中的植物聚酮和间苯三酚途径; 人体没有同源途径。
recovered_entries.daily_amount_zh: 0 (人体没有相应的生物合成途径)
recovered_entries.still_matters_when: Nothing on this axis. The screening question is drug interaction, not deficiency: CYP3A4 induction by hyperforin plus serotonergic additivity with SSRIs and triptans. Also check hyperforin content, since low-hyperforin extracts induce far less.
recovered_entries.still_matters_when_zh: 这条轴上没有理由。筛查要问药物相互作用, 与缺乏无关: hyperforin 诱导 CYP3A4, 加上与 SSRI 和曲普坦的血清素能叠加。还要看 hyperforin 含量, 低 hyperforin 提取物的诱导作用弱得多。
recovered_entries.source: PMID 13129991 (Markowitz JS, JAMA 2003;290:1500-4, Effect of St John's wort on drug metabolism by induction of cytochrome P450 3A4 enzyme)

The label is INTERMEDIATE rather than FULL because 5-HTP is an obligate transient intermediate with no storage pool, no dietary requirement and no measurable body pool, so a FULL label implying adequate endogenous quantity has no quantity to attach to. Tryptophan hydroxylase is the rate-limiting and regulated step, and swallowing 5-HTP forces the pathway past that control point. The consequence is serotonin production wherever aromatic L-ami ...
recovered_entries.endogenous_note_zh: 每个产血清素的细胞都在用膳食色氨酸持续生成自己的 5-HTP, 而且不会积累, 因为下一个酶立刻把它转成血清素。这里标 INTERMEDIATE 不标 FULL, 因为 5-HTP 是必经的瞬时中间体, 没有储存池, 没有膳食需要量, 也没有可测的体内池, 所以 FULL 所暗示的内源量根本没有数字可挂。tryptophan hydroxylase 是限速且受调控的一步, 口服 5-HTP 会把途径推过这个控制点。结果是在任何有 aromatic L-amino acid decarboxylase 的地方生成血清素, 主要是肠道, 而全身大部分血清素本来就在那里, 所以补充带来的是失控, 不构成对短缺的纠正。

recovered_entries.daily_amount: NOT ESTABLISHED. 5-HTP is an obligate transient intermediate with no storage pool, and whole-body synthesis flux has not been quantified in humans. Flux anchor for scale: only about 1 to 2 percent of tryptophan flux ente ...
recovered_entries.daily_amount_zh: NOT ESTABLISHED。5-HTP 是必经的瞬时中间体, 没有储存池, 全身合成通量在人体中未被定量。用于把握量级的通量参照: 色氨酸通量只有约 1% 至 2% 进入羟化酶这条路, 超过 90% 走 kynurenine 途径, 所以 100 mg 的口服剂量远高于它所进入的那条生理支路。
recovered_entries.still_matters_when: Only where bypassing tryptophan hydroxylase regulation is the deliberate aim, and preferably with a peripheral decarboxylase inhibitor such as carbidopa to steer conversion centrally, as used in research settings. Otherwise NEVER ON THIS AXIS: tryptophan intake is the physiological lever, and unopposed 5-HTP alongside an SSRI or MAOI is a serotonin toxicity risk.

recovered_entries.source: PMID 16023217 (Turner EH, Pharmacol Ther 2006;109:325-38, Serotonin a la carte: supplementation with the serotonin precursor 5-hydroxytryptophan)

recovered_entries.supplement: Saffron and other plant mood botanicals
recovered_entries.endogenous_note: Saffron's constituents are apocarotenoids, the crocins plus crocetin, picrocrocin and safranal, cleaved from zeaxanthin in Crocus sativus stigmas. Human tissue makes no part of them, so the axis is silent and the case rests entirely on trial evidence. This row was split from the former combined saffron and SAMe row, which carried a single FULL label over members at opposite ends of the axis.
recovered_entries.endogenous_note_zh: 藏红花的成分是脱辅基类胡萝卜素, 即 crocins 以及 crocetin, picrocrocin 和 safranal, 由 Crocus sativus 柱头中的玉米黄质裂解而来。人体组织不合成其中任何部分, 所以这条轴无话可说, 判断完全依赖试验证据。本行从原先藏红花与 SAMe 合并的那一行拆出, 那一行用一个 FULL 标签盖住了处在轴两端的成员。
recovered_entries.pathway: NOT APPLICABLE. Apocarotenoids cleaved from zeaxanthin by carotenoid cleavage dioxygenase in Crocus sativus stigmas; no human counterpart.
recovered_entries.pathway_zh: NOT APPLICABLE。在 Crocus sativus 柱头中由 carotenoid cleavage dioxygenase 裂解玉米黄质生成脱辅基类胡萝卜素; 人体没有对应途径。
recovered_entries.daily_amount_zh: 0 (人体没有相应的生物合成途径)
recovered_entries.still_matters_when: Nothing on this axis. Screen on trial size and independence (small trials, several from the same groups), adulteration of an expensive spice with dyed safflower or turmeric, the 28 to 30 mg/day extract dose used in trials, and serotonergic additivity.
recovered_entries.still_matters_when_zh: 这条轴上没有理由。改用试验规模和独立性 (样本小, 多项出自同一批研究者), 昂贵香料被红花或姜黄染色掺假, 试验所用 28 至 30 mg/day 的提取物剂量, 以及血清素能叠加来筛查。
recovered_entries.source: PMID 25384672 (Lopresti AL & Drummond PD, Hum Psychopharmacol 2014, Saffron for depression)

recovered_entries.endogenous_note: Psyllium is a highly branched arabinoxylan that no human enzyme can cleave, which is the operational meaning of dietary fibre. Being non-digestible is the mechanism: the husk holds water into a viscous gel and the gel does the work on stool form and transit. So the axis has nothing to say against it, and psyllium is the one fibre with reasonable randomised support in IBS.
recovered_entries.endogenous_note_zh: 车前子壳是高度分支的阿拉伯木聚糖, 人体没有酶能切开它, 这就是膳食纤维的操作性含义。不可消化本身就是机制: 壳把水保持成粘性凝胶, 凝胶作用于大便形态和转运。所以这条轴没有反对它的理由, 而车前子是在 IBS 中拥有较合理随机证据的那一种纤维。
recovered_entries.pathway: NOT APPLICABLE. Dietary fibre is defined by resistance to human digestive enzymes; humans lack the glycoside hydrolases that would depolymerise the arabinoxylan backbone.
recovered_entries.pathway_zh: NOT APPLICABLE。膳食纤维的定义就是耐受人体消化酶; 人缺少能把阿拉伯木聚糖主链解聚的糖苷水解酶。
recovered_entries.daily_amount: 0 (no human biosynthetic pathway; intake is the only variable)
recovered_entries.daily_amount_zh: 0 (人体没有生物合成途径; 摄入量是唯一变量)

recovered_entries.source: PMID 19713235 (Bijkerk CJ, BMJ 2009;339:b3154, Soluble or insoluble fibre in irritable bowel syndrome in primary care?); PMID 24725724 (Jones JM, Nutr J 2014, C ...

recovered_entries.supplement: Wheat bran and insoluble fibre supplements for IBS
recovered_entries.endogenous_note: Insoluble bran is non-digestible by definition, so nothing about it is endogenous and every gram is eaten. Here the axis being silent is not a licence, and the trial record has to be reported in full: in the same primary care trial that supported psyllium, 10 g/day bran did beat placebo at month 3 in the primary analysis (adequate relief 57 percent versus 32 percent, RR 1.70, 95 percent CI 1.12 to 2.57) but not in the worst-case sensitivity analysis of that same result (RR 1.45, 95 percent CI 0.97 to 2.16), and it reduced symptom severity by only 58 points versus 49 for placebo (P=0.61), with symptoms often worse ...
recovered_entries.endogenous_note_zh: 不可溶麦麸按定义不可消化, 所以其中没有内源成分, 每一克都靠吃。这里这条轴无话可说并不等于放行, 而试验结果要完整报告: 在支持车前子的同一项基层医疗试验中, 10 g/day 麦麸在第 3 个月的主分析里确实优于安慰剂 (充分缓解 57% 对 32%, RR 1.70, 95% CI 1.12 至 2.57), 但在同一结果的最差情形敏感性分析中不显著 (RR 1.45, 95% CI 0.97 至 2.16); 症状严重度只下降 58 分, 安慰剂为 49 分 (P=0.61), 头几周症状常加重, 三组中脱落最多 (完成率: 车前子 64%, 麦麸 56%, 安慰剂 60%)。天然粗纤维本身仍不构成理由, 麦麸的信号比车前子更弱也更不稳定。
recovered_entries.pathway: NOT APPLICABLE. Insoluble cellulose, hemicellulose and lignin resist human digestive enzymes; no human synthesis and no human requirement for this specific material.
recovered_entries.pathway_zh: NOT APPLICABLE。不可溶的纤维素, 半纤维素和木质素耐受人体消化酶; 人体不合成它, 对这类具体材料也没有需要量。
recovered_entries.daily_amount_zh: 0 (人体没有相应的生物合成途径)
recovered_entries.still_matters_when: Nothing on this axis, and the trial evidence for bran in IBS is inconsistent: significant at month 3 in the primary analysis, null in the worst-case analysis, no effect on symptom severity, early worsening and the highest dropout. Insoluble fibre still has a role in ordinary constipation and general diet quality; in IBS, prefer a soluble gel-forming fibre.
recovered_entries.still_matters_when_zh: 这条轴上没有理由, 而麦麸在 IBS 中的试验证据不一致: 第 3 个月主分析显著, 最差情形分析为阴性, 对症状严重度无效, 早期加重, 脱落率最高。不可溶纤维在普通便秘和整体膳食质量上仍有作用; 在 IBS 中优先选可溶性成胶纤维。
recovered_entries.source: PMID 19713235 (Bijkerk CJ, BMJ 2009;339:b3154); PMID 24725724 (Jones JM, Nutr J 2014)

The 2017 ISAPP consensus defines a prebiotic as a substrate that is selectively utilized by host microorganisms conferring a health benefit; it deliberately moved away from non-digestibility and imposes no such requirement, so the operative criteria are selective utilisation plus a demon ...

recovered_entries.endogenous_note: The synthesis axis does not fit here at all, because these are living organisms rather than molecules, which is why the label is NOT APPLICABLE rather than NONE: forcing NONE would make a live organism look like a plant alkaloid on a screening table. Human cells cannot manufacture a bacterium, and the resident microbiome is acquired at birth and from the environment and then renews itself, so nobody is deficient in a strain the way someone is deficient in a vitamin. The honest test for a probiotic is strain-level trial evidence for a named indication, since effects do not transfer between strains, let alone betwe ...
recovered_entries.endogenous_note_zh: 合成这条轴在这里完全不适用, 因为对象是活体生物, 不是分子, 所以标签用 NOT APPLICABLE 而不用 NONE: 硬套 NONE 会让活菌在筛查表上看起来像一种植物生物碱。人细胞无法制造细菌, 常驻菌群在出生时和从环境中获得, 之后自我更新, 所以没人会像缺某种维生素那样缺某一个菌株。对益生菌诚实的检验标准是针对具体适应症的菌株级试验证据, 因为效应在菌株之间不能移植, 跨物种更不行。
recovered_entries.pathway: NOT APPLICABLE. Microorganisms are acquired, not synthesised. The resident microbiota is self-renewing and is defined by colonisation history rather than by any host biosynthetic capacity.
recovered_entries.pathway_zh: NOT APPLICABLE。微生物靠获得, 不靠合成。常驻菌群自我更新, 由定植史决定, 与宿主的任何生物合成能力无关。
recovered_entries.daily_amount: 0 (human cells cannot synthesise a microorganism). No daily requirement exists; the resident microbiota replaces itself.
recovered_entries.daily_amount_zh: 0 (人细胞无法合成微生物)。不存在每日需要量; 常驻菌群自我替换。

recovered_entries.endogenous_note: These are living organisms, so the synthesis axis does not apply, and in the ICU the argument runs the other way entirely. The largest randomised trial found no reduction in ventilator-associated pneumonia with Lactobacillus rhamnosus GG, and genomic work traced bloodstream isolates in critically ill patients back to the probiotic capsules they had been given. A compromised gut barrier converts a harmless commensal into an exposure, so the absence of endogenous synthesis is no argument for adding one.

recovered_entries.endogenous_note: All are plant products with no human biosynthetic route, so the axis is silent for the group. Two members are worth separating out. Kava's kavalactones carry the best short-term anxiolytic trial signal in this space and the worst safety signal, idiosyncratic severe hepatotoxicity including transplant cases, which drove regulatory withdrawal in several countries. recovered_entries.endogenous_note: Saffron's constituents are apocarotenoids: crocins, picrocrocin and safranal, cleaved from zeaxanthin in the stigmas of Crocus sativus. Human tissue makes no part of them, so the axis is silent and the case rests entirely on trial evidence. That evidence is positive but thin: mostly short trials at 30 mg/day, several from the same research groups, with independence and adulteration as the main things to check. The same reading applies to the other plant members of this group.

recovered_entries.endogenous_note: These are plant materials, mainly yohimbe bark, Epimedium, maca and Tribulus, so nothing in them is endogenous and the synthesis axis cannot screen them at all. The screening question that does discriminate is adulteration: analytical surveys of herbal sexual enhancers repeatedly recover undeclared synthetic PDE5 inhibitors, including sildenafil and tadalafil and unlicensed structural analogues. That makes an unregulated capsule an undisclosed prescription drug, with the nitrate interaction and cardiac risk that go with it.
